name: MME
intro: MME是一个针对多模态大型语言模型的综合性评估基准。它旨在衡量模型在14个子任务上的感知和认知能力，包括存在、计数、位置、颜色、海报、名人、场景、地标、艺术品、OCR、常识推理、数值计算、文本翻译和代码推理。为避免数据泄漏，所有指令-答案对均由人工设计。
org: Nanjing University, Tencent Youtu Lab, Xiamen University, Chinese Academy of Sciences
build_method: 人工问答构建、每图成对是非问题标注
metric: ACC、ACC+、子任务分数ACC+ACC+、感知与认知总分
intro_en: MME is a comprehensive evaluation benchmark for multimodal large language models. It aims to assess models' perceptual and cognitive abilities across 14 subtasks, including existence, counting, location, color, posters, celebrities, scenes, landmarks, artworks, OCR, commonsense reasoning, numerical calculation, text translation, and code reasoning. To prevent data leakage, all instruction-answer pairs are manually designed.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2306.13394, Section 2. MME covers ten perception subtasks—existence, count, position, color, poster, celebrity, scene, landmark, artwork, and OCR—and four cognition subtasks—commonsense reasoning, numerical calculation, text translation, and code reasoning. It uses COCO and other public images without their original annotations, plus manually photographed and diffusion-generated images; every instruction-answer pair is newly written by humans. Summing the paper's subtask counts gives 1,187 images and 2,374 instruction-answer pairs. Each image receives two concise zero-shot prompts ending with 'Please answer yes or no': one ground-truth yes and one no. ACC is computed per question, ACC+ requires both questions for an image to be correct, each subtask score is ACC + ACC+, and perception/cognition totals have full scores of 2,000 and 800.
